docs.text: Refund policy: customers may request a full refund within 30 days of purchase. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days once the returned item is received.
Partial refunds apply to opened software licenses. Contact billing support with your order number to start a refund request.
To reset your password, click 'Forgot password' on the sign-in page. A reset link is emailed to your registered address and expires after one hour.
Password requirements: at least 12 characters, one number, and one symbol. You cannot reuse your previous five passwords.
Vacation policy: full-time employees accrue 1.5 days of paid leave per month. Unused leave rolls over up to a maximum of 20 days per calendar year.
Standard shipping takes 5 to 7 business days. Express shipping arrives in 2 business days and is available for an additional fee at checkout.
We ship to most countries. International orders may be subject to customs duties that are the responsibility of the recipient.
Enable two-factor authentication in account settings to add a second layer of protection. We support authenticator apps and hardware keys.
Sick leave: employees receive 10 paid sick days per year, separate from vacation. A doctor's note is required for absences longer than three consecutive days.
Parental leave: primary caregivers are entitled to 16 weeks of paid parental leave; secondary caregivers to 6 weeks, to be taken within the first year.
Remote work policy: employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval. A stable internet connection is expected during core hours.
Expense reimbursement: submit receipts through the finance portal within 30 days. Approved expenses are paid out with the next payroll cycle.
Payroll runs on the last business day of each month. Payslips are available in the HR portal two days beforehand.
Health benefits: the company covers 80 percent of medical and dental premiums for full-time staff and their dependents. Enrollment opens each November.
New hire onboarding: complete the IT setup checklist, sign the code of conduct, and attend orientation during your first week.
To access internal systems off-site, connect to the company VPN using your SSO credentials. Contact IT support if the client fails to authenticate.
IT support: raise a ticket through the help desk portal for hardware, software, or account issues. Urgent outages can be reported on the on-call line.
Software licenses are assigned per seat. Request a new license through the IT portal; unused licenses are reclaimed after 60 days of inactivity.
Data retention: customer records are kept for seven years to meet regulatory requirements, then securely deleted. Backups follow the same schedule.
Code of conduct: treat colleagues and customers with respect, avoid conflicts of interest, and report misconduct through the confidential ethics line.
Business travel must be booked through the approved travel portal. Economy fares are the default; upgrades require director sign-off.
The company observes 11 public holidays per year. The holiday calendar is published each December for the following year.
Performance reviews occur twice a year, in June and December. Reviews cover goal progress, peer feedback, and a development plan for the next cycle.
Hardware products carry a one-year limited warranty covering manufacturing defects. Accidental damage is not covered unless a protection plan was purchased.
